summary: Request for per-hour itemized CSV after blended 'reserved + hosted' line on finalized invoice INV-2026-02-9876
description: Issue summary: BrightWrite (dedicated customer) received finalized invoice INV-2026-02-9876 showing a single blended line item for 2026-02-23 23:00-01:00 that appears to be an averaged rate combining reserved capacity and hosted fallback usage. Impact: customer requests a per-hour, per-postback CSV export and an explanation for the blended rate; they are asking for a provisional credit for the apparent overcharge. Invoice delta: $1,843.27 (blended line) vs expected line-itemized total $1,112.00 (customer's calculation) Request: - Provide itemized CSV with per-hour rates, postback ids, and whether each postback was billed at reserved or hosted rate. - Explain why the billing engine created a blended single line. - Issue provisional credit to avoid autopay disputes while we investigate.
steps_to_reproduce: Run mixed workload on dedicated pool and force hosted fallback by saturating reserved pool (simulate spike) between 23:50 and 00:15 UTC
Trigger a large batch job that spans the billing hour boundary (example job id: batch-2026-02-23-bw-42)
Ensure some requests are served by reserved GPUs and some are routed to hosted fallback in the same logical hour
Observe invoice aggregation and check hourly aggregator output and postback ordering
logs: Invoice: INV-2026-02-9876 (finalized 2026-02-24 07:12 UTC) - blended line description: 'Mixed compute - 2026-02-23 23:00-01:00'
Billing aggregator snapshot: RATES-2026-02-23-UTC (applied to invoice run 2026-02-24 06:50)
Rate-card snapshots: ratecard/2026-02-23/region-us-east.json (reserved rates), ratecard/2026-02-23/region-us-east-hosted.json (hosted fallback rates)
investigation_notes: 2026-02-24 11:00 - Support triage: confirmed invoice contains a single aggregated line for the 2-hour window that spans midnight UTC. Customer expectations: itemized per-hour lines.
2026-02-24 13:20 - Engineering (Marcus): initial query to metering service shows postbacks for batch-2026-02-23-bw-42 recorded across two backends; timestamps cross the hourly boundary.

2026-02-24 15:40 - Billing: aggregator applied 'hourly blend' step which currently averages rates when a single billing window contains both reserved and hosted events; this does not emit per-postback detail into the final invoice line by design — but we normally attach a CSV when mixed billing occurs; CSV was not attached due to a late-stage export failure (S3 5xx) during invoice finalization.

Hypothesis: export failure caused the invoice to still contain the blended description but without the supporting CSV; the averaged rate display caused the customer to believe they were overcharged. Need to (a) reproduce export failure locally, (b) re-run per-hour export for INV-2026-02-9876, (c) compute delta and propose provisional credit if rounding/aggregator bug found.
Priority action: obtain raw postback listing for invoice window and produce requested CSV; hold autopay for this invoice until resolution (customer requested).

resolution_notes: 2026-02-26: provisional credit credit-PRV-2026-02-408123 for $731.27 applied pending reconciliation. Billing re-ran per-postback exporter and attached per-hour CSV to the customer invoice. Root cause: transient S3 exporter 503 prevented CSV attachment; aggregation logic correctly averaged rates when producing a single descriptive line, but lack of attachment caused customer confusion. Follow-ups: (1) engineering to add an invoice-finalization blocker when exporter fails to attach (task INT-2310), (2) product to add explicit 'mixed-billing CSV included' flag in UI, (3) billing to notify customers when provisional credits are applied. Customer to confirm reconciliation before we close ticket.
